caption: A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Probe tip near insect; leaf stable; scientist’s gloved hand steady; insect motionless. Unknown: Whether nudge occurs, insect’s reaction, probe contact force.

INTERACTION: Probe contact → insect proprioceptive/nerve response → minimal twitch; leaf stability → maintains insect position → enables controlled nudge.

PERSISTENCE: Insect’s twitch persists only if stimulus remains; probe contact ceases → twitch decays; leaf stability persists → nudge remains effective.

INTERVENTION: If probe contact force increases → twitch may escalate or harm insect; if leaf moves → insect displaced → nudge fails; if scientist’s hand trembles → contact becomes erratic → reaction unpredictable.
